author: Kingsley, 1878

note.en: A small rock shrimp with a hard, stony shell, living on fine sand and mud, known here from a 1971 museum specimen taken at 19 m southeast of Limón.
note.es: Un camarón de roca pequeño de caparazón duro y pétreo, que vive en arena fina y fango, conocido aquí por un ejemplar de museo de 1971 tomado a 19 m al sureste de Limón.

evidence: GBIF/OBIS: USNM specimen, 19 m southeast of Limón (1971)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Caribbean Costa Rica and Bocas del Toro

recWhy: Single 1971 museum specimen taken southeast of Limón.

marks.en: Stiff, hard-shelled rock shrimp with a ridged, rough shell and a toothed ridge along the back.
marks.es: Camarón de roca rígido, de caparazón duro, rugoso y acanalado, con una cresta dentada a lo largo del dorso.
